text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Renting out the entire barbecue area... 
Yayoi really does things on a grand scale!

Suddenly,
Chairwoman Akikawa handed down a 
"mandatory vacation." Arrangements were 
made for me to take some time off 
alongside the hardworking Mei Satake.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No helping it now! Trainer <username>,
let us enjoy 
this to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal! Man, that was 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the scent of the forest, 
munching on sweet carrots roasted over an 
open fire... Yeah, that was a wonderful 
breather!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, couldn't an outlet like this be 
something the Umamusume on away 
expeditions need too?
choice_data_list: It certainly helps relieve the ten...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
It could also serve as a gathering 
spot for Umamusume competing on
unfamiliar 
turf!
choice_data_list: Indeed, I think that would help ea...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Even if we host it,
getting exhausted just 
from travel time defeats the whole 
purpose. Right, for example...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
How about training in a forest where we 
can have a barbecue? Killing two birds 
with one stone! It'll make for a great 
change of pace, too.
choice_data_list: In that case, we should prepare so...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. France has hard water, after all. 
It won't agree with some girls, and they 
might fall ill. In that case, Japanese 
ingredients and—
choice_data_list: In that case, I'd like to prepare ...

text_block_list.text:
Our brainstorming session assuming an 
away-stay got lively...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, we came up with plenty of ideas, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hahahaha! Man... what even is a 
vacation anyway?!
choice_data_list: ...We talked about work until it w...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Couldn't agree more!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Foresight! Knowing how devoted to your 
work you both are, I foresaw things 
turning out this way.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering what I could do to 
help, and before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...What I can do, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Mei really hasn't changed a 
bit! Always looking ahead, constantly 
driving forward. Ever since back then, 
without fail—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Turned down once again...
"It is difficult 
for a Japanese Umamusume to win the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe"... is it?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Regrettable. No matter how passionately I 
conveyed my desire to support
Umamusume... 
we could not secure their backing...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
All I want is to provide a good 
environment...! What will it take to make 
them understand...?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
........If domestic won't cut it, then 
Yayoi, we'll attack from overseas!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mei...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Even if the path is blocked, you just 
gotta do what you can right now!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'll secure a foothold in France! In the 
meantime, Yayoi, focus your efforts on 
training our Umamusume back home!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally... zero objections!! Let's take 
it step by step and build a bridge to
what 
lies beyond our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yes, connecting France and Japan!
Let's do 
it, Yayoi! We are—allies!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since we formed that alliance, 
we've gotten a whole lot done together, 
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Splitting paths, crossing once more, 
and at last, paving the road ahead—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that,
I gained another. A "comrade" 
gazing straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
you too harbor high ambitions 
and charge forward just like us. Will you 
continue to fuel this burning passion 
alongside us?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I would be glad if the answer were
yes, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: A toast to us, allies of the starry sky!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――*clink!*

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
All right! An ally of mine needs to rest 
when duty calls! Behold!! An extra supply 
of camp food!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thoughtful as always, Yayoi! Alright, 
let's feast in style tonight!!
